p: Market Place is the heart of Wigan town centre, with the Grand Arcade, the Galleries and the pedestrian streets all close to hand. This Admiral is an adult gaming centre, which means it's 18+ only.

Wigan Pier, made famous by George Orwell's book, is a short walk south on the Leeds and Liverpool Canal, and Trencherfield Mill nearby is home to a vast working steam engine. For a bigger outing, Haigh Woodland Park on the edge of town has woodland trails, Haigh Hall, play areas and a café. Wigan is also proud of its rugby league, with the Warriors one of the sport's big names, and of its pies; you won't go hungry here.
